purpose: Quarantine policy. Quarantine is allowed only as a named, time-boxed risk surface, never as silent failure hiding.
rules: A quarantined task must keep a manifest id and timing history.
A quarantined task must have an owner note, reason, and exit criterion.
Release gates may exclude quarantined tasks only if the non-claim is explicit.
A task that passes on retry is marked flaky; it is not equivalent to a clean pass.
codename: OPFS Web Lock Quarantine Clearance Replay Key Receipt Integrity Proof
